notes.title: Mini-Tank Arena Patch 1.0.0.
notes.notes:
Changelog


 Set damage pickups to deal 2x damage
 Lowered the sound for pickups
 The spectator camera's position has been fixed for the Tree House level
 Fixed inconsistencies in giving kill credit when killed by objects other than players
 Fixed Defensive tank ultimate (SS) not giving kill credit and skipping the death sequence
